backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a quote request management system with functions to submit, retrieve, search by name, and list all quote requests stored in a Map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four completed features that replaced 'epoxy' with 'polyaspartic' across HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, and Footer components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files describing a polyaspartic coating company website with navigation, hero, services, about, contact sections, and backend integration hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for a concrete-inspired gray and copper design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for NewGate Concrete Coating application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the full website layout with Navigation, HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, and Footer components.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component displaying four benefit cards with icons, company description focused on polyaspartic coatings, and service areas (Orlando, Tampa, Plant City) with MapPin badges.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with validation that submits quote requests to the backend actor, displays contact info (phone, email, location), and shows success state after submission.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with company branding, social media links, quick navigation, contact details, service areas list, polyaspartic coating description, and caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component with background image, company branding, phone CTA, and buttons to scroll to contact/services sections. Includes animated scroll indicator at bottom.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed navigation bar with logo, menu links (Home, Services, About, Contact), and responsive mobile menu. Changes background on scroll and provides smooth scrolling to page sections.
Services section displaying four polyaspartic coating services (patio, driveway, pool deck, garage) in a responsive card grid with images, descriptions, and feature tags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, creating authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all quote requests and submitting new quote requests via the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for concrete-inspired color palette (neutrals, copper accents) in light and dark modes, plus utility classes for theme colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space (including copper, concrete, sidebar themes), container settings, border radius variables, custom fonts (Inter), and animation keyframes for accordions.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting NewGate Concrete Coating website features including hero section, services showcase (patio/driveway/pool/garage coating), about section, contact form, navigation, industrial-modern design theme with earthy tones, and company branding elements.
